items.defectStatement: The PostgreSQL-specific skip prevents the integration test from exercising storage-server startup and eager initialization. The test's resource database configuration hardcodes localhost, whereas Drone runs PostgreSQL at the host supplied by POSTGRES_HOST.
obligations: Run the integration test when GRAFANA_TEST_DB is postgres instead of skipping it.
Use the PostgreSQL test endpoint, preserving localhost:5432 defaults.
Preserve eager initialization and the existing startup and metrics assertions.
Keep connection overrides scoped to this test and preserve other database behavior.
items.notes: Repository inspection confirms that the resource database dynamically honors GF_RESOURCE_API_DB_HOST. This permits a local replacement, but that mechanism and Drone's endpoint variables are absent from the frozen input. Deleting the skip alone leaves the connection mismatch; fixing addStorageServerToConfig is an alternative requiring wider edits.
